evidence_items.explanation: The study defines average inference cost and token consumption alongside resolved-task rates, including unsuccessful problems in the benchmark. This supplies a reproducible task-cost measurement under the stated reading, without establishing complete business ROI.
This supports the narrower concern that agent evaluations often lack comparable, reproducible methods. It does not establish that constructing such measurements is impossible.
